description: Long/short positioning that perp venues publish for one symbol: binance, bybit, gate, okx. The venues do NOT measure the same thing, so every row carries `basis`: binance = top traders by POSITIONS; okx and gate = top traders by ACCOUNTS; bybit = ALL accounts. Compare a venue with itself over time, never as a like-for-like average across venues. `long_share` / `short_share` are fractions of 1 (0.63 = 63 %); `long_short_ratio` = long / short (1.72 = 1.72 longs per short; above 1 is long-heavy). Without `hours`: the newest 5-minute print per venue and its age in seconds (`venues` printed within the last hour, `stale_venues` went silent). With `hours` (1-168): an hourly `long_short_ratio` series per venue, the last print in each UTC hour. Covers about 40 major symbols only; any other symbol returns empty lists and a note, never zeros. `symbol` is the canonical base asset ('BTC').

exchange.description: Only this venue (lower case), e.g. 'okx'. Omit for every venue.

hours.description: Omit for the latest print per venue. 1 to 168 for an hourly series over that many hours.
